name: adv_distill_bad
title: Knowledge distillation with a temperature-softened KL loss - six planted defects
origin: written for the domain-generative-rl-graph hardening round, 2026-09-13
note: This program is the clearest measurement of finding DGRG-03: the loss is produced by a workspace helper whose return is `ALPHA * soft_loss + (1 - ALPHA) * hard_loss`, an arithmetic expression. The returned value carries no tensor type, so loss.backward() at line 87 never resolves to the BACKWARD role and MLV201, MLV202, MLV203 and MLV205 all go silent on a loop that is missing zero_grad and accumulates a live tensor. Only MLV401 fires, and only because its chain is inside the helper.

expected.defect: F.softmax at line 67 feeds F.cross_entropy at line 68
expected.why: the hard-label term log-softmaxes an already-softmaxed vector, so its gradient is flattened and the distillation mix is not the mix ALPHA claims

expected.defect: the batch loop over `loader` calls backward (line 87) and optimizer.step (line 88) but never zero_grad
expected.why: gradients accumulate across every batch of every one of the thirty epochs, so each update is the running sum of the whole run

expected.defect: the running loss keeps the live tensor
expected.why: running_loss is created at line 77, outside both loops, so the autograd graph of every batch of every epoch is retained until train() returns

forbidden.why: the loader is built with shuffle=True at line 100
there is no evaluation loader in this project
the loader is constructed inside main(), which runs only under the if __name__ == "__main__" guard, and num_workers is not set
loss.backward() at line 87 precedes optimizer.step() at line 88 - the order is correct, only the zero_grad is missing
there is no no_grad block in this file, so backward cannot be inside one
there is no binary cross-entropy in this project; F.kl_div with a log-softmaxed first argument and a softmaxed second is the correct KL form
features and labels are both moved to DEVICE at lines 80-81, before either forward pass
DEVICE is chosen by torch.cuda.is_available() at line 16
there is no split call in this project
Teacher.__init__ and Student.__init__ both call super().__init__() on their first line
every submodule is a plain attribute or lives inside nn.Sequential
torch.save is given student.state_dict() and torch.load passes weights_only=True

unsupported.defect: the teacher is never put in eval mode and never frozen, so its Dropout(0.5) fires and its BatchNorm1d running statistics keep being updated by the student's batches
unsupported.why: MLV301's documented eval-region detection is `a loop or a function that runs a forward pass and contains no backward()`. The teacher's forward lives inside the training loop, which does contain a backward, so the region test can never classify it. Nothing in the catalog models `a second model that should be in eval mode inside a training loop`.

unsupported.defect: the teacher logits are not detached, so the soft loss back-propagates into the teacher
unsupported.why: no rule models a missing .detach() on a target tensor.

unsupported.defect: the KL term is not multiplied by TEMPERATURE ** 2
unsupported.why: the missing T**2 scaling is a numerical convention no rule models; at T=4 the soft term is 16x too small and ALPHA no longer means what it says.
